items.heading: Souvlaki
details: Key ingredients: pork, lemon, oregano, pita, tzatziki
Marinate cubed pork in lemon juice, olive oil and oregano.
Thread the meat onto skewers.
Grill over hot coals, turning until charred and juicy.
Serve wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki and fresh vegetables.

items.heading: Halloumi Saganaki
details: Key ingredients: halloumi cheese, flour, lemon, olive oil
Slice halloumi cheese into thick pieces.
Dust lightly with flour.
Pan-fry in olive oil until golden and lightly crisp on both sides.
Serve immediately with a squeeze of lemon.
